answers.moment: I don't think there was one single moment for me, it was more the feeling of the whole call. It was really easy & quick, lots of laughing, and I didn't have to work hard to keep it going (usually with strangers I'm the one filling the silences). I ended up laughing at myself quite a lot about being the spreadsheet person. There was one bit where I worried I sounded a bit too 'ward pharmacist' and preachy, but it passed fast.  Overall very warm, like chatting to a neighbour :)
answers.reason: It felt so relaxed compared to what I expected, honestly.
